milestones.title: The workbench runs Node with the RHEL 9 OpenSSL FIPS provider on a FIPS host
The hosted cryptography inventory lists the condition with an item for your organization's authorizing official

remediation: Node's bundled OpenSSL and Electron's BoringSSL run without FIPS mode. The hosted workbench moves to Node with the RHEL 9 OpenSSL FIPS provider on a FIPS host (Phase 46). The desktop extension has no validated path, so your organization uses it only where its policy does not require a validated module, or its authorizing official accepts the condition. X8 covers the same point for the export overlays.
title: The extension's Node and Electron cryptography does not run in a validated module
